scope: benchmark capacity-preflight scripts ONLY; provider request content and preflight gate thresholds/threshold logic byte-identical (verified: probe functions, gate composition, disposition strings and exit codes untouched)

contract: caller names the output path explicitly on every invocation
atomic exclusive create (os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL, mode 0600) — an existing file is NEVER opened for writing, so a failed or aborted run cannot modify it
OutputPathError raised on an existing path (scripts map it to a distinct exit code 3)
